epic.title: epic-418-followon wave 2 — F2: MCP door adoption (#542) and friction capture (#541)
epic.intent_and_why: The MCP front door from F (#424) is built, merged and unused. Make agents drive through it, and make the door confess its own friction while they do. C (#421) does not launch until this is done: agents running the spine through the door is C's entry condition, set by the repo owner.

definition_of_done: Role spine instructions name the door's tools as the default path, CLI documented as the remaining fallback.
A real dispatched agent drove a real role spine to done through the door alone, measured from its own call record.
install_constellation.py ships and wires .mcp.json, so a fresh install gets the door.
The server's own rejections land in the run's episode through apply_episode_delta.py, and say so loudly when they cannot.
The identity trade is decided and the property given up is written down.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Every gate closes on evidence produced AT that gate. No gate check that cannot lose.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Targeted automated tests plus the full suite at 0 failed; the acceptance claim measured from the driving agent's own call record, never server-side.
good_enough.appetite: One wave, one PR on epic-418/f2-mcp-adoption.

hard_constraints: The CLI door stays. F is additive. An edit that removes the CLI path fails g4a.
Never edit scripts/checklist_engine.py — the door wraps the engine and never re-implements it.
episodes/ is written only through apply_episode_delta.py with --store-root episodes.
An episode is a record, never read back as a rule.
Never write settings.json at user scope.
Do not reintroduce per-dispatch MCP config generation on identity grounds.
The main checkout /home/tommy/projects/constellation-skills is fenced read-only.
fixed_decisions: Gate order is g1 identity, g2 capture, g3 installer, g4 adoption+acceptance — the order is the point.
The acceptance numerator is the driving agent's own call record, never the server log.
A measured negative is a complete deliverable; an UNMEASURED condition is not a negative.
Identity may be bound to a container only at the granularity that container genuinely separates (g1).

current_wave.objective: Adopt the MCP door as the default path and instrument the door's own rejections.
exit_criteria: All five definition_of_done items evidenced, each at its own gate.

issues.title: Adopt the MCP door
issues.desired_outcome: Agents default to the door; a fresh install ships it; a real dispatched agent drives a real role spine to done through it alone.
issues.useful_now: It is C (#421)'s entry condition. C is written against whichever door delivers gate imperatives, so doing C against the CLI and porting afterwards is doing it twice.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: The driving agent's own record.jsonl scored by F's archived instrument, requiring reached_done AND zero CLI engine invocations; plus the three adoption counts re-measured.
issues.implementation_latitude: Which role spines change and in what order; tool grouping; how the acceptance run is staged.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Removing or deprecating the CLI path.
local_unknowns: Whether an installed project-root dotfile should be default or opt-in — the installer has no precedent for writing one.

issues.title: Capture the door's own friction into the run's episode
issues.desired_outcome: The door records its own rejections, they reach the run's episode through apply_episode_delta.py, and it fails loud on every occurrence when they cannot.
issues.useful_now: The door absorbs rejections that used to be diagnosable in a transcript; without capture, adoption trades a visible defect for a silent one.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A seeded rejection scored by the instrument; a real episode written and read back under a nested work-id and verified with verify_episode_captured.py; N>=2 induced write failures producing N separate messages.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not extend the Mechanical allowlist or edit apply_episode_delta.py, episode_capture.py or docs/EPISODE_STORE.md — all outside this run's ownership.
Do not overload the engine's refusals counter or failed-commands.
Nothing written into episodes/ may be phrased as guidance for a future agent.

wave_forecast.outcome: C (#421) relocates gate-specific instructions into the spine, written against the door rather than the CLI.
wave_forecast.why_likely: The repo owner set 'agents running the spine through the door' as C's entry condition, and C's hard constraint is that the gate imperative rides tool results verbatim.
entry_conditions: F2 complete: role spine instructions default to the door and a real dispatched agent has driven a real role spine through it.

uncertainty_register.affects: Whether the g1 position is a permanent answer or an interim one.
uncertainty_register.settle_by: Its own design, as docs/CHECKLIST_ENGINE_DESIGN.md already records.
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: Neither ${VAR} expansion nor per-dispatch config generation reaches the case; identity scoping is per top-level process, not per agent-turn.
uncertainty_register.next_probe: Not probed in this wave. g1 states what the fleet does UNTIL such a design exists, not that one is unnecessary.

uncertainty_register.unknown: Whether the acceptance run will produce any door rejections at all.
uncertainty_register.affects: How much g2's capture can be demonstrated live rather than by seeded control.
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: F measured ZERO malformed calls in both DC5 arms, so zero is the expected reading.
uncertainty_register.next_probe: Report whatever number it is. Zero is a result and will not be manufactured away.
